title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 109 (Rwai Shlur Ki Hima Vol. 16)
khasi_title: Rwai Shlur Ki Hima Ba-paka No. 109
cultural_context: Chronicles the defense of mountain states and ancestral autonomy. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha ki lum ba pyngngad ka ri,
Sawa ka sur ba thiang tam;
Ki sim ki rwai halor ki tnat,
Ban pyndap ia ka dohnud da ka jingsuk.
lyrics_english:
Across the cool mountain ranges of our land,
Resounds the sweetest melody of all;
The birds sing atop green boughs,
Filling our hearts with enduring peace.
